reviews.text: We took our three Golden Retriever dogs to DoggyDeluxe. The place is truly luxurious, with a perfect setup and professional staff. Our dogs came home happy and well taken care of. I highly recommend this place.
The best dog boarding house in Budapest!🙌 …

The idea itself is brilliant, but the design of the place is also absolutely fine! If we could communicate with dogs verbally (there are certainly those who can, or there are technical means for this, but I have not encountered such a thing yet), I am sure that we would only hear words and sentences of appreciation and praise from them! A free, clean, airy large (although this is relative) space, where dogs can roam, play and eat and drink to their heart's content, from a wide range of delicacies specially made for them and certainly for them, for them! The seller is a nice, nice guy who knows perfectly well and also suggests what and why it is the way it is, and what and why, and how he does it to make both the dogs and their owners feel good (a good example of this is the dog birthday party, for which you can even rent out the entire place and invite the dog's "friends" to the special day, holiday, so that the anniversary of his birth is unforgettable for our pet too!

I found them this year, our 4-year-old French bulldog jumped out of the car happily from the 2nd time because he knew he had come to the right place. He also comes here on vacation because there is everything a bulldog needs for happiness. The guesthouse is located in the most beautiful part of Budafok, the owner is kind and flexible. Every day, lots of pictures are taken of the puppies, so you can follow how the puppies are bandaging themselves from afar. I can only recommend it.
Very good for dogs. Mine goes with pleasure.
